snippet.title: Blastron - Universal - HD Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Blastron by Kabam

Your robots are armed and ready for battle. It's time to Blast or be Blasted!

Launch yourself into the awesome world of Blastron, home of the universe's most extreme Robotic Sport - Blastbots! Explore thousands of ways to blow up your fellow robots, while collecting awesome loot, upgrading and customizing your robots...and did we mention, blasting the crap out of other robots!?!?

Collect an arsenal of insane weapons designed for maximum annihilation while upgrading an array of unique robot parts to level up your skills. It's a blast or be blasted kind of world out there, SO GET BLASTING!

Game Features:

FAST PACED TURN BASED BATTLES
Shoot your way to the top of the Blastron Hall of Fame leaderboard

COLLECT AND UNLOCK A HUGE VARIETY OF WEAPONS AND BOOSTS
Crush your opponents and score maximum points

UPGRADE YOUR ROBOT'S PARTS
Create thousands of unique robot blasting combinations

STRATEGICALLY GRAB LOADS OF EPIC LOOT
Score tons of weapons and items and rack up points to help your shoot to the top of the leaderboard

PLAY IN CAMPAIGN MODE
Battle your way to the Blastron championship title and unlock new weapons and robots for use in multiplayer modes

So what are you waiting for? Join the world of Blastron and Get Blasting!
